title: The Fourth Path
next_chapter_hook: The dimensional invader truly looked at this ant for the first time—it said: "You are worthy of knowing the truth of the higher dimension."

text.content: Amid the roar of the Three Realms collapsing, Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm: "I will take the fourth path—the path that breaks all chess games." The heavens overturned, laws crumbled, yet he stood at the center of this destruction, composed as if discussing the weather. Dimensional rifts tore open a ghostly blue wound behind him, and countless laws higher than three dimensions seeped from that wound like venom dripping into clear water.

dialogue.content: All three paths lead to death. Following the Heavenly Dao, I become another chess piece; going against the heavens, I won't even leave a trace; secluding myself, you all continue this game of devouring the Three Realms. And I—Chen Ji, the废物 servant of the Tianqing Sect, today will flip this chessboard right under your noses.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment manifested in Chen Ji's palm, its runes flickering wildly, as if sensing the call from higher dimensions. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled: "Have you thought this through? Entering the dimensional rift means voluntarily stepping into the hunter's territory. Opposing a four-dimensional consciousness with a three-dimensional body—success rate less than one in ten thousand." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that grin cold enough to freeze and crack metal and stone.

dialogue.content: One in ten thousand? Master Mo, you underestimate me far too much. The futures I saw in the Tianji Record are not limited to just one way to die. On the contrary, I saw the only path to survival—right at the deepest part of that rift. You said the Tianji Record is a chess piece set by the Heavenly Dao, so let me show the Heavenly Dao what it feels like when a chess piece turns against the board.

choice.prompt: The dimensional rift was right before Chen Ji—he needed to decide how to enter: charging in directly, or making more preparations?

choices.text: Charge in directly, face it head-on
choices.description: With the full power of Heavenly Fate Unity, charge directly into the dimensional rift, displaying absolute dominance.
choices.visible_reward: Gain brief visual advantage inside the dimensional rift
choices.risk_hint: If failed, will be torn apart by dimensional chaos

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for even a moment. The full power of Heavenly Fate Unity exploded within him, golden light blazing from his body. He took one step, his form turning into a golden stream of light, directly crashing into that ghostly blue rift. Dimensional chaos instantly engulfed him—countless laws higher than three dimensions cut through his soul like blades—pain, pain beyond words.

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record as a medium, fuse with four-dimensional power
choices.description: Utilize the resonance between the Tianji Record Fragment and dimensional power to transform oneself into a vessel capable of bearing four-dimensional laws.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes massive Tianji Record energy, requires allies to assist in stabilization
choices.risk_hint: If interrupted during fusion, existence will be erased by dimensional power

text.content: Chen Ji spread open the Tianji Record. The runes on the fragment began rotating on their own, resonating with the dimensional rift. Su Qingyao's figure suddenly appeared at his side, hands pressing down on his shoulders, stabilizing his soul with inner sect methods.

choices.text: Send the Tianji Record ahead first, scout the situation
choices.description: Launch the Tianji Record Fragment into the rift as a vanguard, enter afterward, minimizing risk to the greatest extent.
choices.visible_cost: Tianji Record may be damaged, temporarily losing prophetic abilities
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete intelligence on the interior of the rift
choices.risk_hint: Once the Tianji Record is eroded by dimensional power, consequences may be irreversible

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment flew from Chen Ji's palm, transforming into a stream of light shooting into the dimensional rift. In that instant, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a pained cry: "Something is watching me—an existence higher than me in dimension!" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, firmly recording that moment of sensation in his heart. This was his enemy, his true enemy in every sense.

Inside the dimensional rift was a space that defied description. No up or down, left or right, no flow of time—only endless ghostly blue light streams shuttling through. Chen Ji's body was enduring unimaginable pressure; a three-dimensional shell continuously distorting, tearing, and reforming in four-dimensional space. Were it not for the protection of Heavenly Fate Unity, he would have long been torn into nothingness by dimensional chaos.

dialogue.content: "A three-dimensional ant dares to step into my domain?" Information beyond sound itself flooded directly into Chen Ji's consciousness—that was the will suppression from a higher dimension. At the core of this space, a humanoid outline flickered into view. It had no face, only a pair of eyes composed of countless geometric figures, gazing down at Chen Ji "from above."

text.content: Chen Ji felt the weight of that will—enough to crush an ordinary cultivator's soul into powder. Yet the corner of his mouth slowly lifted, that smile carrying a chilling madness. He slowly raised his head, staring into those geometric eyes: "Ant? You overestimate yourself. In my view, you so-called four-dimensional beings are nothing but frogs in a well, trapped within your own dimension."

dialogue.content: "Oh?" That will slightly rippled, as if feeling some amusement, "You do have some courage. For a three-dimensional creature to remain mentally clear after stepping into four-dimensional space—this is the second time in ten thousand years. The first was the one who brought the Tianji Record into the three dimensions—what was his name? Chen Xuan?" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. This name touched the most sensitive nerve.

choice.prompt: The dimensional invader mentioned Chen Xuan's name—Chen Ji's ancestor and the original master of the Tianji Record. How does Chen Ji respond to this topic touching on family secrets?

choices.text: Conceal agitation with anger, strike back forcefully
choices.description: Mention that Chen Xuan is the Chen family ancestor, take pride in it, while mocking the dimensional invader's arrogance.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the relationship with Chen Xuan may invite more targeted attacks
choices.visible_reward: Display the pride of Chen family bloodline, leaving a deep impression on the invader
choices.risk_hint: The dimensional invader may use this to threaten or probe

text.content: Chen Ji laughed uproariously to the sky, that laughter carrying a trace of desolation: "Chen Xuan is my Chen family ancestor! The Tianji Record originally belongs to my Chen family! You self-proclaimed superior beings have manipulated us as chess pieces for thousands of years—and today—it is my turn to move the pieces!" His voice echoed through dimensional space, making those ghostly blue lights tremble.

choices.description: Pretend not to know Chen Xuan, guide the dimensional invader to reveal more information about the original prophet.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as weakness, losing initiative
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence about Chen Xuan and the origin of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The dimensional invader may see through the intent, increasing attacks instead

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, hiding the vibration in his gaze without a trace: "Chen Xuan? Never heard of him. The Tianji Record is merely something I obtained by chance, unrelated to any ancestor. Since you know so much, why not tell me—what do you truly want from invading three dimensions?" His tone was calm, yet concealed sharp edges.

choices.visible_cost: 错过获取关键情报的机会
choices.visible_reward: 展现绝对自信，可能迫使入侵者认真对待
choices.risk_hint: 后续可能因情报不足而陷入被动

text.content: Chen Ji sneered coldly, taking out the Tianji Record Fragment from his怀中. The runes on it flickered wildly: "Who Chen Xuan is has nothing to do with why I'm here today. I only ask you one thing—Three Realms collapsing, laws reshaping—are you seeking destruction, or rebirth?" The fragment in his palm transformed into a brilliant light, pointing directly at that humanoid silhouette.

The dimensional invader's geometric eyes suddenly contracted. A mighty will pressed down like a tide: "You are far more interesting than Chen Xuan. When he entered here back then, his mouth was full of righteousness and morality, yet his heart was filled with fear and schemes. And you—" Its voice paused, "There is no fear in your eyes." Chen Ji stood at the center of that will's storm, robes fluttering in the wind, yet his soul was faintly glowing.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The dimensional invader's attitude actually changed subtly, "A three-dimensional creature able to withstand my will suppression in four-dimensional space—not because of how strong you are, but because your existence itself is anomalous. That 'Heavenly Fate' aura on you is abnormally dense—exactly who are you?" Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, the power of Heavenly Fate Unity gathering into a tiny point of light in his palm.

choice.prompt: The dimensional invader showed genuine interest for the first time. Chen Ji needed to decide how to respond to this question—"Who exactly are you?"

choices.text: Reveal all cards, display true strength
choices.description: Release the complete form of Heavenly Fate Unity, letting the invader witness the limits a three-dimensional being can reach.
choices.visible_cost: Expose all hidden手段, losing flexibility in subsequent battle
choices.visible_reward: Gain the invader's true respect and intelligence from higher dimensions
choices.risk_hint: If unable to truly threaten the invader, will completely infuriate it

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath. The power of Heavenly Fate Unity fully bloomed within him. Golden light poured from every pore of his body, condensing into a complete humanoid form in four-dimensional space—that was him, yet more sublime, more perfect than him. The Tianji Record's runes circled around him, perfectly merging with his Heavenly Fate power. For the first time in four-dimensional space, a three-dimensional existence capable of resonating with dimensional laws had appeared.

choices.text: Dangle bait, trade intelligence for cooperation
choices.description: Tell the invader you know the true secrets of the Three Realms' core, willing to use this as leverage for an equal dialogue.
choices.visible_cost: Expose having crucial leverage, may be threatened later
choices.visible_reward: May gain partial support or intelligence from the dimensional invader
choices.risk_hint: The invader may turn hostile and directly snatch

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly,收敛了周身的气势: "Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is—I know the true secrets of the Three Realms' core. The complete form of the Tianji Record—you've searched for countless eons without finding it. And I, perhaps, can make your wish come true." His words echoed through dimensional space. The geometric eyes of that silhouette suddenly lit up.

choices.text: Seize the initiative, launch direct attack
choices.description: No more废话, attack with thunder-like momentum, prove your value of existence with strength.
choices.visible_cost: Consume large amounts of Heavenly Fate Value, may not inflict substantial damage on the invader
choices.visible_reward: Display extraordinary courage, disrupt the invader's rhythm
choices.risk_hint: May be instantly countered, but may also create unexpected opportunities

text.content: Before the words even finished, Chen Ji had already moved. Heavenly Fate Unity's power transformed into a brilliant sword light, slashing directly toward that humanoid silhouette. Four-dimensional space剧烈震荡 under this strike—countless geometric figures began twisting, collapsing. The dimensional invader let out a low roar: "An ant's rage can also burn four dimensions—you are indeed no ordinary chess piece!"

The dimensional invader's form changed for the first time. That silhouette was no longer flickering but completely solidified. It had no face, yet those geometric eyes revealed something never seen before—interest. "Interesting, Chen family descendant." Its voice was no longer pure will suppression, but carried a thread of seriousness, "In ten thousand years, the first three-dimensional creature to dare strike at me. You are worthy of knowing the truth of higher dimensions."

dialogue.content: "You think we are 'invading'? You think the Heavenly Dao's Eye is your enemy?" The dimensional invader let out a low laugh, that laughter echoing through four-dimensional space, "Wrong. We are here only to harvest. The fate of the Three Realms was sealed from the moment you three-dimensional beings were born. Tianji Record, prophets, Heavenly Fate children—all of this is already a script we have written. What you call 'rebellion' is precisely the nutrients we need."

text.content: Chen Ji stood still, digesting the information in those words. His expression showed no波动, those eyes still calm as water: "So you allowed the Tianji Record to spread, allowed prophets to rise—all to cultivate us as 'nutrients'? Then—" He slowly raised his head, a chilling smile curling at the corner of his mouth, "What if I told you, I knew what I was from the very beginning? I walked this path not to rebel in the first place, but to—assimilate?"

dialogue.content: The dimensional invader's geometric eyes contracted sharply: "What do you mean?" Chen Ji raised high the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand. The runes on it no longer flickered but condensed into a towering pillar of light: "The Tianji Record is not merely a prophecy, but a contract. You used the Tianji Record to bind Heavenly Fate children, wanting to absorb our power. But you forgot—contracts work both ways." The pillar of light pierced into the core of four-dimensional space. Countless laws began violently shaking.

text.content: "What are you doing!" For the first time, the dimensional invader lost its composure. Its form began distorting—countless geometric figures疯狂旋转. Chen Ji's voice rang out clearly through the chaos, calm and steady: "I? I am completing what you failed to accomplish—making three and four dimensions truly merge. Not invasion, not destruction, but—dimension ascension." The Tianji Record's pillar of light resonated with the dimensional rift. The collapse of the Three Realms suddenly stopped, replaced by an even more terrifying power awakening.

dialogue.content: The dimensional invader's voice carried trembling for the first time: "You've gone mad! This will cause both dimensions to collapse simultaneously! You will die!" Chen Ji looked at that distorted figure, revealing a sincere smile for the first time: "Die? From the day I obtained the Tianji Record, I never intended to leave alive. I was just thinking—if both three and four dimensions were destroyed simultaneously, would those high-and-mighty existences go to the grave together with me?"

text.content: Outside the dimensional rift, all beings in the Three Realms witnessed that terrifying scene—the sky tore open a massive wound, ghostly blue light pouring from the wound, while simultaneously a golden pillar of light erupted from within Chen Ji. The two forces met, collided, fused at the rift's center. From the Xuanwu Sect's direction, Han Lie gripped his fists tightly—he felt the will contained in that power, a path entirely different from his own, yet equally chilling.

"You—" The dimensional invader's voice abruptly stopped, because in that golden pillar of light, it saw something impossible—a three-dimensional creature forcibly fusing its Heavenly Fate with four-dimensional laws, enduring the terrifying pressure of two dimensions collapsing simultaneously, yet still smiling. That smile held no madness, only a calm that froze the blood. Chen Ji spread open his arms, welcoming everything to come: "Come then, tell me—what exactly is this 'truth of higher dimensions.'"

At this critical moment, the dimensional invader's form suddenly stabilized. Its geometric eyes fixed on Chen Ji, revealing a complex light: "You win." These three words echoed through four-dimensional space, causing Chen Ji to slightly freeze. The invader continued: "Not because you are stronger than us, but because your madness exceeded our calculations. The dimension ascension ritual cannot be stopped once initiated, and you have already pushed it to an irreversible stage—including ourselves."

The dimensional invader's voice carried a thread of recognition for the first time: "Chen family descendant, you are indeed worthy of knowing the truth. The Heavenly Dao's Eye is not some lofty existence—it is merely the projection of dimensional will. We—including all beings of three dimensions—are also just ants in the eyes of higher dimensional existences." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The dimensional invader let out a low laugh: "The 'ultimate villain' you thought you faced is merely a chess piece in an even larger game. And now—"

"Now, this chess game is completely chaotic." The dimensional invader's form began dissipating, dissolving into countless points of light融入那道金色光柱: "The dimension ascension ritual will reshape all laws, including our form of existence. After that—either we all transcend together, or we all perish together." Chen Ji felt those points of light flooding into his body. Heavenly Fate Unity's power was undergoing some indescribable transformation. His consciousness began blurring, yet at the last moment heard the invader's final words—

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, you are the most interesting ant I have ever encountered. Next volume—I will seriously play chess with you." The dimensional rift began contracting violently. The collapse of the Three Realms stopped, but instead, an even more terrifying aura was gathering. Chen Ji floated in place, surrounded by golden Heavenly Fate light and ghostly blue four-dimensional laws. The two forces were slowly merging within his body, forming an unprecedented new realm. In the distance, Su Qingyao's figure pierced through the collapsing space to reach him, eyes filled with shock and worry.

text.content: The dimensional invader truly regarded this "ant" for the first time—it said: "You are worthy of knowing the truth of higher dimensions." Beyond the Three Realms, in higher dimensions, countless gazes beyond comprehension simultaneously turned toward this space undergoing dimension ascension. The prelude to an even greater storm was thus sounded.
